display_long_description:
🤝 Online Co-op Multiplayer

Run a supermarket together with up to 4 players. Divide tasks, coordinate your work, and grow your business faster as a team. Whether you're stocking shelves, organizing products, or working the checkout, every player contributes to the success of the store.

[media]

🏪 Build & Customize Your Store

Create the supermarket you've always wanted. Arrange shelves, place furniture, organize products, and redesign your layout whenever you want. Sell unwanted furniture and optimize your store for maximum efficiency.

[media]

📦 Manage Inventory & Grow Your Business

Order products, fill shelves, adjust prices, and make smart business decisions. Expand your store, increase profits, and transform a small shop into a successful supermarket empire.

[media]

🚨 Hire Employees & Stop Shoplifters

Hire employees to help manage daily operations and keep your business running smoothly. Stay alert for shoplifters trying to steal products and protect your store before they get away.

[media]
